q: The quantum information spectrum approach defines the spectral inf-entropy rate of a sequence of states {ρ_n} as:
opts: The von Neumann entropy of the limit state
exp: Spectral inf-entropy: H̄(ρ) = sup{R : Tr[ρ_n · 1_{ρ_n ≥ 2^{nR}}] → 1}. This is the operational minimum compression rate for the state sequence {ρ_n} in the one-shot/non-i.i.d. framework. For i.i.d. states ρ^⊗n, H̄ = S(ρ) (the von Neumann entropy).
